info.name: DSP Film Manager API — Final Lab01
info.description: Deterministic manual and Runner workflow for the single final Lab01 server. Run Reset collection state after every server restart.

exec: pm.cookies.jar().clear(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl'), (error) => { if (error) console.warn('Cookie jar clear failed; run Logout before unauthenticated checks.', error); });
console.log('Runtime collection state cleared. Static credentials and baseUrl were preserved.');

pm.test('Navigation links are complete and contain no placeholder', () => { pm.expect(body).to.include.keys('self','publicFilms','ownedFilms','invitedFilms','reviewAssignments','users','session'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include('/change/me'); });

pm.test('Film pagination is coherent', () => { pm.expect(body.films).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.currentPage).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.totalItems).to.be.at.least(body.films.length); pm.expect(body.totalPages).to.be.at.least(1); });

pm.test('Public films do not leak private-only fields', () => body.films.forEach((film) => { pm.expect(film.private).to.eql(false); pm.expect(film).not.to.have.any.keys('watchDate','rating','favorite'); }));
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('publicFilmId')) { console.log('Skipping: publicFilmId is not available in this server run.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

pm.test('Public film links are valid', () => { pm.expect(String(body.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('publicFilmId')); pm.expect(body.self).to.eql('/api/films/public/' + body.id); pm.expect(body.reviews).to.eql('/api/films/public/' + body.id + '/reviews'); });

item.name: List reviews of public film anonymously

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('publicFilmId')) { console.log('Skipping: publicFilmId is not available in this server run.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('publicReviewFilmId') || !pm.collectionVariables.get('publicReviewerId')) { console.log('Skipping: seeded public review not available.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

pm.test('Review identity and self link match', () => { pm.expect(String(body.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('publicReviewFilmId')); pm.expect(String(body.reviewerId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('publicReviewerId')); pm.expect(body.self).to.include('/reviews/' + body.reviewerId); });

pm.test('Users are safe and navigable', () => { pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); body.forEach((user) => { pm.expect(user).not.to.have.any.keys('password','passwordHash','hash'); pm.expect(user.self).to.eql('/api/users/' + user.id); }); });

const secondary = body.find((user) => user.email === pm.collectionVariables.get('secondaryLoginEmail')); pm.expect(secondary, 'secondary seeded user').to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('secondaryUserId', String(secondary.id)); pm.collectionVariables.set('invitedReviewerId', String(secondary.id));

const primaryId = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('currentUserId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('otherReviewerIds', JSON.stringify(body.filter((user) => user.id !== primaryId && user.id !== secondary.id).slice(0,2).map((user) => user.id)));
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('invitedReviewerId')) { console.log('Skipping: invitedReviewerId is not available in this server run.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

pm.test('Requested user is safe', () => { pm.expect(String(body.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('invitedReviewerId')); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.any.keys('password','passwordHash','hash'); pm.expect(body.self).to.eql('/api/users/' + body.id); });

pm.test('Created film is correct', () => { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.private).to.eql(false); pm.expect(String(body.owner)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('currentUserId')); pm.expect(body.self).to.include('/api/films/'); });

item.name: Create private film with rating zero

exec: pm.test('Created film is correct', () => { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.private).to.eql(true); pm.expect(String(body.owner)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('currentUserId')); pm.expect(body.self).to.include('/api/films/'); });
pm.test('Rating zero and boolean favorite are preserved', () => { pm.expect(body.rating).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.favorite).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('Created film is correct', () => { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.private).to.eql(false); pm.expect(String(body.owner)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('currentUserId')); pm.expect(body.self).to.include('/api/films/'); });

pm.test('Owned list contains the created private film', () => { pm.expect(body.films).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.currentPage).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.films.map((film) => String(film.id))).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdPrivateFilmId')); body.films.forEach((film) => pm.expect(film.private).to.eql(true)); });

const body = [{ filmId: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdReviewFilmId')), reviewerId: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('invitedReviewerId')) }]; pm.request.body.raw = JSON.stringify(body);

pm.test('Invitation is incomplete and linked', () => { pm.expect(body).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(String(body[0].filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdReviewFilmId')); pm.expect(String(body[0].reviewerId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('invitedReviewerId')); pm.expect(body[0].completed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body[0].self).to.include('/reviews/' + body[0].reviewerId); });

const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('otherReviewerIds') || '[]'); pm.expect(ids.length, 'two additional seeded users').to.be.at.least(2); pm.request.body.raw = JSON.stringify(ids.map((reviewerId) => ({ filmId: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdPublicFilmId')), reviewerId })));

pm.test('Invitation appears in reviews collection', () => { pm.expect(body.reviews).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('films'); pm.expect(body.reviews.map((review) => String(review.reviewerId))).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('invitedReviewerId')); });

const used = new Set([Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('invitedReviewerId'))]); const reviewerId = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('otherReviewerIds') || '[]').find((id) => !used.has(id)); pm.expect(reviewerId, 'available reviewer').to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('removableReviewerId', String(reviewerId)); pm.request.body.raw = JSON.stringify([{ reviewerId }]);
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('removableReviewerId')) { console.log('Skipping: removableReviewerId is not available in this server run.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

pm.test('Created film is correct', () => { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.private).to.eql(false); pm.expect(String(body.owner)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('currentUserId')); pm.expect(body.self).to.include('/api/films/'); });

pm.test('Created film is correct', () => { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.private).to.eql(false); pm.expect(String(body.owner)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('currentUserId')); pm.expect(body.self).to.include('/api/films/'); });

pm.test('Every eligible film is assigned exactly once', () => { pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); const expected = [pm.collectionVariables.get('createdBalancedFilmId1'), pm.collectionVariables.get('createdBalancedFilmId2')]; const actual = body.map((item) => String(item.filmId)); expected.forEach((id) => pm.expect(actual.filter((value) => value === id)).to.have.length(1)); pm.expect(actual).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdPrivateFilmId')); pm.expect(actual).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdReviewFilmId')); body.forEach((item) => pm.expect(item).to.include.keys('filmId','reviewerId')); });

pm.test('New assignment distribution is balanced when measurable', () => { const totals = {}; body.forEach((item) => { totals[item.reviewerId] = (totals[item.reviewerId] || 0) + 1; }); const counts = Object.values(totals); if (counts.length > 1) pm.expect(Math.max(...counts) - Math.min(...counts)).to.be.at.most(1); });
pm.test('Second assignment call is idempotent', () => pm.expect(body).to.eql([]));
